achievable_gc_rule: For each residue independently, the lowest and highest GC content reachable with an allowed codon; summed over residues and divided by the ORF length in nucleotides. Codon choices are independent, so these bounds are attained and therefore exact.
description: The constraint set this campaign asks you to assess. forbidden_codons and gc_global_min are additional to the composition constraints in composition_limits.json; gc_global_min REPLACES the host's gc_global window for this campaign.
forbidden_codons_rationale: Disallowed by the synthesis vendor for this order; treat the list as given.
